intro.text: A clinic sells trust before it sells a treatment. What follows are three levels of the same approach, from a steady monthly presence to a full rebuild of how the clinic looks and speaks online. Every level is planned in advance, so nothing is invented on the shoot day.

notes.title: What a reel means here
notes.body: Ten reels means ten finished pieces, not ten single unbroken takes. A long continuous take is used when it earns its place, to honour a treatment done well or to let a specialist finish a thought without a cut.

notes.title: Clients on camera
notes.body: Nobody is filmed without written permission, and no treatment is shown in a way that identifies a client unless they have agreed to it in writing. We bring the release forms and handle them on the day, so your team does not have to.

notes.title: Your client portal
notes.body:
Every collaboration comes with a personal portal, included in all three packages. Each step we take, plan or consider is visible there, so you always know where the month stands without having to ask.

The plan for the month, the shoot day, the pieces in edit, the finished deliverables and the posting calendar all live in one place, updated as we work.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: We agree the pieces for the month and the day to film them, chosen around your consultation hours so the clinic keeps running.

steps.title: Film
steps.text: One session on site. Everything for the month is captured in that day, reels and photographs together, worked calmly against the plan.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: You receive the finished pieces with the posting guide telling you what goes out and when across the coming weeks.
